notes: Feeder package rebuilt: design_rules [], collisions [] (static, elevation sweep, azimuth sweep, new feed-stroke sweep); az inertia 0.3475 vs 0.35 limit (close). Host tests against the simulated board: the old firmware fails 4 of 15, count-at-open fails 2. Local verification: python unittest (PYTHONPATH=src, tests/) 67 OK; node --test sim/page/usage 21 pass; CAD suite 56 tests: first full run had 3 failures in my new tests (GATE_OUT_MS 850 was 7 ms short of the CAD's 0.857 s with the 0.448 kg shuttle -> 900; a probe point off the plate; a rule test parameter that did not trip), fixed and the 27 affected tests re-run OK; the other 53 passed in the full run on the same package. Python suite also caught that the new gate code left the servo unpulsed at power-up; it now holds GATE_LO_US every idle tick.
